summary.hu: Az egyiknek egy szeme van, a másiknak kettő, a harmadiknak három.
summary.en: One has one eye, another has two, the third has three.
summary.ro: Una are un ochi, alta două, a treia trei.

summary.hu: Az anya először a két idősebb lányt akarja férjhez adni.
summary.en: The mother wants to marry off the two older daughters first.
summary.ro: Mama vrea să le mărite mai întâi pe cele două mai mari.

summary.hu: Ezért elküldi a legkisebb lány kérőjét.
summary.en: So she sends the youngest daughter's suitor away.
summary.ro: De aceea îl alungă pe pețitorul fetei celei mai mici.

summary.hu: De van egy varázskecske, és segít.
summary.en: But there's a magic goat, and it helps.
summary.ro: Dar există o capră fermecată, și ea ajută.

summary.hu: A végén a legkisebb lány hozzámegy ahhoz, akit szeret.
summary.en: In the end the youngest marries the one she loves.
summary.ro: La final cea mai mică se mărită cu cel pe care îl iubește.

words.en: to get married (said of a woman)

questions.qEn: How many daughters does the woman have?

questions.q: Hány szeme van a harmadik lánynak?
questions.qEn: How many eyes does the third daughter have?
